name: Sam Altman
flavorText: Fired on a Friday, rehired by Tuesday.
dailyBlurb: The industry's chief fundraiser and lightning rod — chips, energy, and AGI timelines all route through his calendar.

name: Ilya Sutskever
tagline: Deep learning pioneer, co-founder of SSI
flavorText: Saw something. Still hasn't said what.
dailyBlurb: Runs the most secretive lab in AI with the largest per-employee war chest ever assembled. Nobody knows what's inside.

name: Andrej Karpathy
tagline: Teacher of a generation of AI builders
flavorText: Teaches a generation to build GPTs, one YouTube video at a time.
dailyBlurb: The field's favorite teacher. One video from him moves more people into AI than a semester of courses.

name: Demis Hassabis
flavorText: Chess prodigy, game dev, Nobel laureate. Pick a lane? Never.
dailyBlurb: A Nobel Prize later, still treats AGI like a chess endgame — patient, positional, inevitable.

name: Jensen Huang
tagline: NVIDIA founder-CEO, the man selling the shovels
flavorText: The jacket is load-bearing.

name: Geoffrey Hinton
tagline: Godfather of deep learning, Nobel laureate
flavorText: Spent 40 years being right too early. Now spends them being worried on time.
dailyBlurb: The godfather who quit to warn about his own life's work. When Hinton speaks about risk, hearing rooms fill.

name: OpenAI
tagline: Frontier lab behind GPT and ChatGPT
flavorText: Started as a nonprofit. The rest is a governance case study.
dailyBlurb: Every product cycle still orbits them: each launch resets the industry's roadmap and X's timeline in the same hour.

name: Dario Amodei
flavorText: Wrote the scaling laws, then built a lab to survive them.
dailyBlurb: Writes essays about machines of loving grace, then signs compute deals the size of small nations.

name: Yann LeCun
flavorText: Invented the ConvNet and will reply to your tweet about it.
dailyBlurb: The frontier's in-house contrarian: insists LLMs are a dead end while his lab open-sources the evidence either way.

name: Elon Musk
tagline: xAI founder, OpenAI co-founder, chaos accelerant
flavorText: Co-founded OpenAI. Currently suing OpenAI. Long story.

name: Liang Wenfeng
flavorText: Ran a quant fund, got bored, moved NASDAQ with a side project.
dailyBlurb: The quant who made frontier AI a commodity. Every pricing page in the industry is a response to him.

name: Google DeepMind
flavorText: Solved protein folding, still can't ship a consistent product name.
dailyBlurb: The deepest bench in AI research. When they focus on one thing — protein folding, weather models, math olympiads — records fall.

name: NVIDIA
tagline: The silicon every model trains on
flavorText: Sells shovels. Owns the gold rush anyway.
dailyBlurb: Still the tollbooth on every training run that matters. Watch the export-control headlines to know their mood.

name: Greg Brockman
flavorText: Codes through the night, tweets through the board crisis.

name: Mira Murati
flavorText: Ran OpenAI twice: once as CTO, once for a weekend.
dailyBlurb: Two billion dollars raised on a blank page. The bet is entirely on her judgment.

name: Yoshua Bengio
flavorText: Most-cited living scientist. Uses the citations to ask you to slow down.
dailyBlurb: The most-cited scientist alive now spends his citations on AI-safety policy. Governments actually call back.

name: Fei-Fei Li
flavorText: Labeled the internet so machines could finally see.

name: Andrew Ng
tagline: Coursera co-founder, AI educator at scale
flavorText: Has onboarded more people into AI than any university.

name: Jeff Dean
flavorText: Latency numbers fear him.
dailyBlurb: Google's living infrastructure legend — the systems he built two decades ago still carry today's models.

name: Noam Shazeer
flavorText: Co-wrote the transformer, left to make chatbots girlfriends, came back for $2.7B.

name: Jan Leike
flavorText: Left superalignment to go do superalignment somewhere else.

name: Eliezer Yudkowsky
flavorText: Has been warning you since before your lab existed.

name: Alexandr Wang
flavorText: Labeled data until Meta labeled him chief.

name: Aravind Srinivas
flavorText: Will personally reply to your complaint about citations.

name: Anthropic
flavorText: Founded by people who left OpenAI to worry more professionally.
dailyBlurb: The safety lab that keeps accidentally shipping the developers' favorite model. Claude's enterprise run is the quiet story of the year.

name: Meta AI
tagline: Open-weights at planetary scale with Llama
flavorText: Spends billions training models, gives them away to ruin everyone's margins.

name: xAI
flavorText: Built a gigawatt datacenter faster than most companies build a landing page.
dailyBlurb: The fastest datacenter buildout in history, wired to the world's loudest distribution channel.

name: Mistral
flavorText: Seven-page memo, four billion euros. Europe's entire AI strategy in a hoodie.
dailyBlurb: Europe's one real seat at the frontier table, balanced between open weights and sovereign-AI contracts.

name: Hugging Face
flavorText: The only place where 'download a stranger's weights' is a business model.
dailyBlurb: The GitHub of models — every open-weights release lands here first, and their download charts are the field's pulse.

name: Clément Delangue
flavorText: Open-source's most relentless hype man. The emoji is load-bearing.

name: Arthur Mensch
flavorText: Left DeepMind with a slide deck, came back with a country's GDP.
dailyBlurb: Europe's frontier-lab founder, fluent in both attention mechanisms and Brussels.

name: George Hotz
flavorText: Jailbroke the iPhone at 17. Now jailbreaking the GPU monopoly.

name: Aidan Gomez
flavorText: Eighth author, first to say attention was all he needed.

name: John Schulman
flavorText: Wrote PPO, then taught your chatbot manners.

name: Chris Olah
flavorText: Opens the black box, finds another black box, publishes beautifully anyway.

name: Sundar Pichai
tagline: Google CEO steering the Gemini era
flavorText: Runs the company whose paper started all of this.

name: Satya Nadella
tagline: Microsoft CEO who bet the company on Copilot
flavorText: Turned a 49% stake into the deal of the century. Maybe.

name: Mark Zuckerberg
flavorText: Spent billions on the metaverse, pivoted to llamas.

name: Microsoft
tagline: Copilot everywhere, plus the OpenAI alliance
flavorText: Enterprise pilots: dozens. Case studies: pending legal review.

name: Apple
tagline: On-device AI for two billion devices
flavorText: Their API status page is the industry's heartbeat monitor.

name: Amazon
tagline: Bedrock, Nova and the AWS machine
flavorText: Went viral once. The servers remember.

name: DeepSeek
tagline: Frontier weights at a tenth the cost
flavorText: Shipped o1-class reasoning for the price of a nice dinner.
dailyBlurb: Proof that frontier AI doesn't require frontier budgets. Every efficiency paper since has been chasing their cost curve.

name: Perplexity
flavorText: Answers your question, then asks for your default search engine.
dailyBlurb: The first real dent in the search monopoly in twenty years — and every browser deal makes it bigger.

name: Midjourney
flavorText: No investors, no sales team, no problem.
dailyBlurb: Zero investors, nine figures of revenue, and half the internet's fantasy art. The bootstrapped anomaly.

name: Cursor
flavorText: Your IDE now finishes your thoughts.
dailyBlurb: The fastest-growing developer tool ever built. The 'AI writes the code' future is already their present.

name: ElevenLabs
flavorText: Your favorite podcast voice might be them.
dailyBlurb: The voice layer of the internet. Every audiobook, dub and agent demo you've heard lately probably rents their larynx.

name: Scale AI
tagline: The data engine behind frontier runs
flavorText: The pick-and-shovel play that got acquired by the gold mine.

name: Cohere
flavorText: Serving enterprise clients you've heard of with models you haven't.

name: Groq
tagline: LPUs serving tokens at ludicrous speed
flavorText: Says tokens-per-second the way others say good morning.

name: Runway
flavorText: Hollywood pretends not to use them.
